name: Granite Belt

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Shiraz, Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: A Queensland wine region. Shiraz is the most planted grape, at 18%, followed by Chardonnay, Cabernet Sauvignon and Verdelho.
